title: BC Forest Planning and Practices Regulation
description: Selected evidence and threshold screens across planning, practice and roads. Each rule lists the exceptions the regulation makes to it, which a reviewer claims on a raised finding with a rationale and evidence; the finding stays raised. Consult the complete source catalogue for companion duties and discretion.

rules.title: Cutblock size · 40 ha regions
rules.finding: The net area to be reforested exceeds the regional limit.

actions.description: Confirm the net area and region. Reduce the net area to the limit, or claim the exception the block relies on with its evidence.

exceptions.label: Salvage of damaged timber, a sanitation treatment, or a design matching a natural disturbance opening, with the block left resembling one (§64(2))
evidence: The damage, the treatment or the natural disturbance design

exceptions.label: The harvest retains 40% or more of the stand’s basal area (§64(3))
No point of the net area to be reforested is more than two tree lengths from the boundary or a reserve of 0.25 ha or more, or one tree length from a smaller reserve (§64(4))
evidence: The tree-length buffers, measured from stand height, over the net area to be reforested

exceptions.label: An approved forest stewardship plan with an intended result or strategy for wildlife and biodiversity at the landscape level (§12.4)

evidence: The plan’s result or strategy and the area it applies to

rules.title: Standing basal area in riparian management zone
rules.finding: Standing basal area is below the applicable table percentage.

actions.description: Verify the preharvest denominator and representativeness under (1)(b). Review stream-bank stability under §52(2), including applicable S6 sites.

rules.title: Conflict with an established objective
rules.finding: Conflict with an established objective needs a case-specific determination.

actions.description: Verify the approved FSP result or strategy, established objective, conflict, exemption and any conditions. Check instruments already in effect under (3).

rules.title: Secondary structure in a targeted pine leading stand
rules.finding: The harvest takes a targeted pine leading stand without keeping its secondary structure.

actions.description: Lay the block out to retain an adequate stocking density of suitable secondary structure, or document the exception that applies. A retained tree counts toward the stocking standard (§43.1(3)).

exceptions.label: Felling or modifying a safety hazard tree, with no other practicable option (§43.1(1)(a))
Building a road through the stand, with no other practicable location (§43.1(1)(b))
The timber is at significant risk of blowdown (§43.1(2)(a))
At least 30% of the pine holds live mountain pine beetle at harvest (§43.1(2)(b))
Harvest needed to protect a community, or an area the minister agreed to before harvest, from wildfire (§43.1(2)(c))
Seed collection leaving an opening of 1 ha or less (§43.1(2)(d))
A ministerial exemption for a forest operations plan holder, where the plan addresses the matter at least as effectively (§4.51)
evidence: The forest operations plan’s requirement or measure for the matter

rules.title: Bank stability on a direct tributary
rules.finding: Trees that hold the bank or channel of a small stream flowing directly into a larger stream or sensitive marine area must be kept in enough number to keep it stable.

actions.description: Mark the trees that hold the bank and channel in the riparian management zone and keep them, whoever cuts there: §52(2) binds every authorized person, not only minor tenures.

exceptions.label: A ministerial exemption for a forest operations plan holder, where the plan addresses the matter at least as effectively (§4.51)
evidence: The forest operations plan’s requirement or measure for the matter
